reviewBasis.scope: Independent explanatory-design review of every ch08-ch14 ID in the all61 first-draft snapshot. The reviewer did not author these diagrams.
reviewBasis.decisionBasis: The decisions and issues in records refer to the initial snapshot, not subsequently edited live files. The separate liveDiffReview describes the author's self-fixes without rewriting the snapshot verdicts.
method: Read docs/ch08.md through docs/ch14.md and the corresponding supplied original/chNN.md in full.
Read both snapshot SVG variants and the question, answer, summary, alt, source locators and anchor for every reviewed ID.
Used view_image on gallery-light-019.png through gallery-light-040.png and all matching dark sheets. Each sheet contains the desktop drawing and the mobile drawing.
Also viewed both themes of sheets 065 and 066 to compare original figures 9.3, 10.1 and 10.2, and sheet 011 to assess overlap with ch05-http-read. Read that comparator's snapshot SVGs and metadata.
Read the insertion logic to evaluate proposed chapter placement. No build, live browser run, source edit, asset edit or shared-reader edit was performed.

Diffed the eleven live files identified in the follow-up, refreshed three metadata diffs when they changed again, and inspected the additional ch10-range-overlap.svg edit disclosed by that metadata. Live changes were assessed from text and SVG structure only.
limitations: This is explanatory design judgment, not a real reader experiment. No comprehension, speed, retention or learning improvement was measured.

The gallery is a 1440-pixel-wide composite with a 680-pixel desktop SVG and a separately displayed 360-pixel mobile SVG. It is not a capture of the full chapter at actual desktop and phone breakpoints.

Placement findings use snapshot anchors, chapter prose and the read-only insertion logic in docs/.vuepress/reader/content.mjs:73-92. Actual chapter scroll rhythm, reader captions, zoom, screen-reader behavior and smaller phone sizes were not rendered here.

Empty outside/overlaps arrays in the supplied gallery index do not establish semantic or visual correctness. In particular, text-text geometry checks do not catch a path crossing text or a selection highlight cutting through a glyph.
The old gallery is not evidence that the author's live self-fixes render correctly. Main must re-render and obtain a second pass.
Retention has no numerical target. Retirement recommendations preserve the underlying source explanation and do not imply the source topic is unimportant.

records.question: 同样的文本编辑工作，为什么换接口能减少调用者的负担？
records.expectedAnswer: 整行接口把拆分和合并行的工作留给界面的多个操作；任意字符范围接口把它封装进文本类。内部若仍按行存储，这项工作仍须完成，并不是消失了。
records.graphicReasoning: The repeated warm blocks above the boundary become one warm block below it, while both caller paths remain. That is an inspectable change in responsibility, not merely two favorable/unfavorable captions. It adds a different lesson from ch11's interface comparison: where repeated work lives. The metadata answer is supported, and the conditional line-based representation is correctly retained in the footer.

sourceEvidence.evidence: Keystrokes and selections motivate partial-line/multiline work. Internal splitting and joining is conditional on a collection-of-lines representation. Chapter 8's character-oriented interface supports arbitrary ranges, unlike Chapter 11's individual-character candidate.

issues.description: The snapshot desktop path M429 160V244 passes through the text beginning at x387,y203. This is visible in both themes and interferes with the crucial statement that the interface expresses an edit range.
The title, repeated labels and accessible descriptions abbreviate joining lines as 并行, a term readily read as parallel execution. The source uses splitting/joining lines, not concurrency.

requestedChanges: Keep the repeated-to-shared responsibility structure and the conditional internal representation.
Use 拆分 / 合并行 consistently in visible labels, title, alt and descriptions.
Move the central label entirely clear of both caller connectors; verify this at the final display size.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: The horizontal comparison and stacked comparison retain the same boundary and convergence. The mobile footer preserves the line-storage condition.
viewEvidence.readability: Main labels and boundary are readable in both themes, except for the desktop path-text crossing.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 8.1 is appropriate, after the prose and the translator's distinction between the two meanings of character-oriented.

limitations: Two caller categories are a teaching decomposition, not measured call counts or a requirement that every keystroke split a line. Live fixes are assessed separately.

records.question: 哪些参数适合由模块自己确定，哪些知识仍应由用户提供？
records.expectedAnswer: 协议可测量成功请求的响应时间，动态计算合理重试间隔；用户可能更了解业务紧迫性，适合提供优先级。应比较谁能确定更好的值，确需配置时考虑合理默认值。
records.graphicReasoning: The fixed configuration path has no measurement return path; the dynamic path closes a feedback loop from successful responses to later intervals. This makes adaptation versus stale configuration visible. The separately placed priority case prevents the loop from being generalized into a ban on configuration. The response-time multiple is left unspecified, as in the source.

sourceEvidence.evidence: The source contrasts domain knowledge about urgency with automatically measured response times, and asks whether users can choose better values and whether reasonable defaults are possible.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: The feedback loop changes orientation but not meaning. Both retain successful responses, later requests, the user-priority exception and default-value guidance.
viewEvidence.readability: Loop and labels are legible in both themes; the return path is clearly separated from the forward path.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 8.2 follows the example and its qualifying questions, so the diagram works as a synthesis.

limitations: This is an illustrative feedback relationship, not a complete transport algorithm, retry-success guarantee or measured optimal policy.

records.question: 为什么移动拆行逻辑是封装，移动退格键逻辑却可能是信息泄露？
records.expectedAnswer: 文本类负责范围编辑；界面负责把退格事件、光标和选区解释为删除范围。只应下沉与核心职责相关、能简化其他代码及接口的复杂性。
records.graphicReasoning: A labeled range crosses the boundary, while the direct backspace-policy route is crossed out. The useful distinction is what information crosses, not merely which box is lower. This complements the preceding responsibility diagram by showing the limit of its advice. The figure does not invent a specific rule for how backspace treats an empty selection, a line start or a character boundary.

sourceEvidence.evidence: Pulling down is qualified by related functionality, simplification elsewhere and a simpler interface. Moving UI-specific backspace knowledge into the text class does not meet the example's rationale.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: Both variants preserve the range-only normal path, the prohibited policy bypass and the three-part qualification.
viewEvidence.readability: The red bypass remains distinguishable by a cross and dashed line, not color alone. Text and boundary labels are legible.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 8.3 is appropriate: it qualifies the preceding examples rather than introducing an unconditional lower-layer rule.

limitations: The range-conversion path is a teaching synthesis of 8.1 and 8.3, not literal source code. The later alt-only wording cleanup does not change the snapshot keep verdict.

records.question: 只负责读取 HTTP 请求的方法，真的不需要理解请求格式吗？
records.expectedAnswer: 书中读取方法为了判断请求何时结束也须理解格式；合并读取与解析可集中这份知识，并消除跨类传递原始请求字符串的接口。

However, the premise that reading requires format knowledge is only asserted inside a box. The already-present ch05-http-read supplies a concrete, explicitly bounded request trace that explains that premise, while 9.2's short paragraph directly explains the eliminated interface. This first draft adds too little to justify another large before/after diagram.

sourceEvidence.evidence: The source explicitly revisits the earlier HTTP example and then identifies the request-string interface that disappears.
The comparator shows Content-Length: 4 and four ASCII body bytes, preserves the multiple-read qualification, and limits itself to that framing case.

issues.description: The question repeats the stronger Chapter 5 diagram's main question. The new graphic's distinctive interface-elimination point is already concise and explicit in 9.2.

requestedChanges: Retire this supplemental SVG pair while retaining the original 9.1 and 9.2 prose.
Use the existing Chapter 5 reference for the concrete framing explanation. Do not add another full protocol drawing merely to replace the retired figure.
Preserve the distinction that an inter-module string interface disappears, not a claim that the combined implementation cannot use strings internally.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: The principal claim is equivalent, although mobile relies more on prose than the desktop's duplicate knowledge nodes.
viewEvidence.readability: No material clipping or contrast problem was observed. Retirement is about explanatory value, not a rendering defect.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 9.2 is locally coherent but repeats a story already explicitly revisited by the prose.

records.question: 选区和光标经常一起变化，为什么这个例子仍然适合分开表示？
records.expectedAnswer: 组合对象仍须让高层分别操作选区和光标，并用布尔值选择端点才能取得光标位置。独立的 cursor Position 可直接读取；有选区时光标仍在其一端，无选区时光标也仍存在。
records.graphicReasoning: The branch selecting one of two endpoints, contrasted with direct storage, explains an extra representational step. This is useful beyond the prose. The endpoint relationship is also worth drawing, but its snapshot rendering and the desktop-only downward arrow compromise precisely the relationship that should be clarified. No universal claim that cursor and selection must always be separate is warranted.

sourceEvidence.evidence: The cursor always exists, selection can be absent, and the endpoint invariant is conditional on selection existing. The combined object has two booleans; the revised design uses reusable Positions, not dedicated cursor/selection classes.

issues.description: Only desktop contains M517 167V214, an arrow from cursor: Position toward the selection heading. It suggests a derivation, dependency or processing sequence absent from the source and absent on mobile.
The snapshot start boundary crosses the b glyph. The blue cursor and green end marker use different x coordinates, making the asserted coincidence look like two adjacent positions.

The drawing mentions a has-selection field but never explicitly says that the cursor remains when selection is absent. The only illustrated state is a selection. The conditional footer should not leave the absent-selection case to inference.
Branch labels lie against the vertical branch paths in the snapshot, making endpoint labels harder to scan.

requestedChanges: Remove the cursor-to-selection arrow; show independent storage with a separately labeled conditional invariant.
Use stable character cells or individually positioned glyphs, with selection boundaries between characters and the cursor at exactly the selected endpoint.
Add a short visible qualification that selection may be absent but cursor Position still exists. Do not invent a sentinel or an empty-selection encoding.
Move branch labels off their paths. Keep the scope limited to this design example and do not frame the difference as a measured performance benefit.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: Not fully equivalent in the snapshot because only desktop has the cursor-to-selection arrow. Both show problematic glyph/boundary positioning.
viewEvidence.readability: Text is readable in both themes, but the geometry weakens the endpoint claim. The blue/green distinction cannot compensate for non-coincident positions.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 9.5 follows the revised Position design and is appropriate.

records.question: 把一条错误日志提成方法，为什么可能让阅读更费力？
records.expectedAnswer: 在书中很浅、各只调用一次且依赖情境的包装方法中，调用处和日志正文需互相参照。把记录语句放回检测点能集中相关信息并去掉包装接口，但不意味着删除通用 logger。

The lower arrangement then colocates context and recorded fields while leaving the generic logger outside. This adds a compact explanation of why the shown code is awkward, without duplicating the original code at full length or confusing the arrows with recursive runtime calls.

sourceEvidence.evidence: The wrapper records req, dest and e; its methods are shallow and each is called at one location. Both directions of reading dependency and the recommendation to inline these statements are explicit.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: Both preserve the opposing reading questions, colocation afterward, retained generic logger and limited scope.

records.question: 索引越界或起点大于终点时，怎样仍给出明确结果？

records.question: 统一处理程序如何处理新错误，又不理解每种错误的细节？

records.graphicReasoning: The drawing has a legitimate information-boundary idea, but most of its area is a generic normal/error lifecycle and boxes stating who knows what. A single arrow labeled common base plus message does not let the reader inspect what is carried unchanged or why another error can reuse the same handler. Original figures 10.1 and 10.2 already establish handler aggregation and its location. A narrower payload/contract drawing would add the missing inference instead of a third broad workflow.

issues.description: The question asks how a new error works without new handler knowledge, but neither a concrete error payload nor a second error using the unchanged contract appears. The claimed extension behavior is a sentence under the diagram.

The normal-response bypass and next-request routing dominate the graphic, competing with the intended knowledge separation. They add little beyond the source's existing figures and lifecycle paragraph.

requestedChanges: Replace the generic workflow with a compact message-contract illustration using the two error messages already supplied in 10.7.

Show two detection sites producing the same shaped base-exception/message record, then the same unchanged response-building operation using the supplied message. Visually distinguish specific-error knowledge from response-format knowledge.
Keep a concise request-level scope note: abort this request, clean up as appropriate, continue with the next; exclude system-fatal exceptions.

records.question: 重试后完成操作，与吞掉错误后假装成功，有什么区别？
records.expectedAnswer: 正确屏蔽在内部处理异常并履行操作承诺；吞错却未完成操作，会使调用者失去必要的失败信息。只有外部不需要这份异常信息时才适合隐藏，并不能保证重试或网络最终成功。
records.graphicReasoning: The completed path includes work before success; the crossed-out path jumps from an error to supposed success. The separate unfinished/failure-information path preserves the external obligation. This is useful qualification of the chapter's earlier error-reduction advice. The visible graphic is more careful than two of the snapshot's accessible/metadata descriptions.

sourceEvidence.evidence: The source distinguishes useful low-level handling from the student team's excessive masking, and makes outside need for information the criterion. It does not limit exposure to failures proven irrecoverable.

issues.description: Snapshot metadata alt says 不可恢复且调用者需要知道. The graphic instead says 未完成，且调用者需要知道, which is the better qualification. A recoverable failure may still require caller action or knowledge.

The desktop SVG desc calls discarding errors 不是异常屏蔽, whereas the source describes it as masking taken too far. The lesson is inappropriate masking, not a categorical redefinition that makes the counterexample disappear.

requestedChanges: Align alt with the visible unfinished-and-caller-needs-to-know condition.
Describe the crossed-out case as inappropriate/excessive masking in the SVG description.
Retain the visible success precondition and external-information requirement. Do not add an unconditional eventually-delivered promise or treat every pending retry as a reportable failure.

viewEvidence.desktopMobile: Visible paths preserve equivalent meaning and conditional success. The issues are in snapshot metadata/desktop desc, not a missing success condition in the rendered mobile drawing.
viewEvidence.readability: The valid paths and crossed-out shortcut are readable in both themes.
viewEvidence.placement: End of 10.9 is appropriate and does not displace the source's separate NFS discussion.

limitations: This is a contract distinction, not a comprehensive retry state machine. Both identified wording issues have subsequent live source fixes; rendering and integrated accessibility readback remain pending.
